summary: Coeur d'Alene National Forest lookout in Kootenai County, Idaho: a 30-foot pole tower with L-4 cab built in 1934 and destroyed in 1950; drive-up site.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1950 per all four sources; a WillhiteWeb photo caption says the footing is almost covered

evidence.supports: built 1934 as a 30-foot pole L-4 tower; destroyed 1950
site is in the Coeur d'Alene National Forest
built 1934 with a 30-foot pole tower and L-4 cab
evidence.quote: In 1934, there was a 30-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab.

evidence.supports: views to the south and west after logging
evidence.quote: For now, this summit has some great views to the south and west thanks to some logging.

evidence.supports: most cars should be able to reach the site
evidence.quote: The access is really good and most cars should be able to make it.

evidence.supports: Initial Peak is listed on the Kootenai County page

notes_for_editor: Four sources agree on the 1934 tower and the 1950 destruction, and the brief record's 1950 event matches. Added the 1934 build event. Today: an undated WillhiteWeb photo caption (footing almost covered), an undated 'for now' remark on the same page about views and access, and the Idaho Fire Lookouts drive-up tag; no source states public access, so no access key. Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 4060 ft; not stored as a fact key. No staffing or fire sources found, so none written. Verification 2026-10-10: the story previously said no source described the site as it is now, which contradicted the caption and 'for now' remark; reworded. All 13 quotes were found on the first run.
